mage.title: 法師
mage.notes: Purple hooded split robe, ivory V front, leather crossed harness, purple orb staff and belt spellbook

swordsman.title: 劍士
swordsman.notes: Navy and ivory split surcoat, layered silver pauldrons and gauntlets, blue cape, straight steel sword

archer.title: 獵人
archer.notes: Forest hooded cloak, ivory undershirt, crossed brown leather harness, bracers, quiver and curved wood/gold bow

assassin.title: 刺客
assassin.notes: Charcoal layered leather, high red-lined collar, torn red scarf tails, crossed harness, paired red-edged daggers

priest.title: 祭司
priest.notes: Ivory and gold mantle, dark navy inner stole, long white split robe, cross motifs, radiating sun staff

novice.title: 初心者
novice.notes: Rough brown hooded poncho, frayed layered tunic, simple stitched trousers, worn leather belt/pouches and wooden club as work-order weapon

paladin.title: 聖騎士
paladin.notes: Royal blue and white tabard, silver/gold plate armor including greaves, chained mantle, gold-rimmed white/blue kite shield and sword

berserker.title: 劍仙
berserker.notes: Flowing ivory crossed martial robe, navy cloud borders, wine-red sash and ribbons, long straight sword with ornate red/gold guard

marksman.title: 神射手
marksman.notes: Tailored navy/gold long coat, shoulder filigree and mantle, monocular aiming lens, blue-feather quiver, tall ornate gold/navy bow

ranger.title: 遊俠
ranger.notes: Leaf-embroidered green hood/cloak, cream shirt, asymmetrical leather straps and pouches, wrist bracers and recurve bow; bird is portrait companion, not welded to character

summoner.title: 召喚師
summoner.notes: Orange-gold hooded long robe, purple lining, leather waist grimoire, orange flame staff; summoned flame/golem remain separate gameplay entities

ninja.title: 忍者
ninja.notes: Indigo wrap tunic, long blue scarf tails, bandaged forearm guards, navy sash and pouches, short straight ninja blade and belt kunai

shadowdancer.title: 影舞者
shadowdancer.notes: Plum and violet split-tail leather coat, magenta lining and ribbons, black undersuit, paired hooked green-edged blades; shadow double is a separate skill effect

bishop.title: 主教
bishop.notes: Ivory/gold ceremonial robe with purple stole and embroidered panels, pointed white/purple mitre, openwork gold crozier and left-hand grimoire

inquisitor.title: 審判者
inquisitor.notes: Sleeveless ivory/gold high-collar coat, black chest, gold shoulder/forearm armor and sunburst chest insignia; right-hand ornate pointed golden polearm follows portrait
